title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, you gotta be hungry! Try some of my onigiri. They're great!

title: Talk 1
original: I've got a lotta hobbies: martial art sparring, soccer… Oh! And Ikebana! Some took me as a warrior with more brawn than brains, and I'd say they're the ones who's got a fat head!

title: Talk 2
original: My race eats other races? That's some old crap! Who told you that? Tch, those cowards, cooking up this nonsense behind my back. When I find'em, I'll give'em a lesson they'll never forget!

title: Talk 3
original: I'm born with this self-healing body. Even if I take a few cuts in the fight, the wounds will close back up in no time.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Hey, Doctor, Rhodes Island's got a soccer tournament! C'mon, let's sign up together! No need to think twice! Just put me in your team, and it's in the bag. You'd better work your brain elsewhere, like a cool victory pose!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: You don't even recognize me on the battlefield? I just start cutting through enemies with a face as cold as my blade? Wow! Sounds hella badass! Wish I could watch myself out there.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I got this problem where I kinda end up breaking stuff, so I'm working with my Ikebana teacher to control my strength. Besides, getting surrounded by all those pretty flowers makes me real happy!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Strategy? Ehh, not really my forte. That's why I keep hopping right into the enemy's plans. But you, Doctor, you always stop me right before I lose my mind. Real nice to have you by my side.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Actually, I've always been a gullible dummy. Got duped so bad in the past that I almost got myself killed a few times. But now I, Matoimaru, swear loyalty to you, Doctor! Because I know you'll never betray me.

title: Idle
original: Grr... Hey, no falling asleep, Doctor! I need a listener or I'm gonna die of boredom!

title: Onboard
original: Matoimaru, here to join Rhodes Island! My blade is at your command, Doctor!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: More fancy skills to beat those bad guys with!

title: Promotion 1
original: Doctor, put my strength to good work. That'll be the respect I deserve.

title: Promotion 2
original: Doctor, please stand back a bit. I don't want to hurt you when swinging my naginata. But I, Matoimaru, will bring us every victory in your name.

title: Added to Squad
original: Hah hah! You all look pretty tough. How about a warm-up with me?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Ugh, you want me to play captain? Then how am I suppose to throw myself into the battle!?

title: Depart
original: You guys ready to rumble? Then what are we waiting for!?

title: Begin Operation
original: Sorry to keep you waiting, bad guys!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm over here.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Just how long until it's my turn?

title: Deployment 1
original: Love that battlefield smell.

title: Deployment 2
original: Make 'em shake in their boots!

title: In Battle 1
original: Standing up to me? Haha, Ballsy!

title: In Battle 2
original: Ready to meet your demise?

title: In Battle 3
original: My blade shall rip you and your toy to ribbons!

title: In Battle 4
original: You end here!

title: 4-star Result
original: A sea of fire and a mountain of blades... Now that's what I call a fight. This is the battlefield I've always dreamed of.

title: 3-star Result
original: Doctor, I got 'em all! Huh? What happened here? Everything's busted… Um, wait a second, did I do it...?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I'll get 'em before they escape! Can't call the battle over unless we got every last of 'em!

title: Operation Failure
original: Retreat! I'll cover your escape. Make sure you don't get hit!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Agh! Ow! My horn...!

title: Tap
original: Huh?

title: Trust Tap
original: What's with that smile on your face? Anything to share with me?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Hey, Doctor, how does Rhodes Island celebrate the New Year? Oh, anything is welcome? Haha, alright then, I'll put together a soccer match with Matterhorn and the others! Make sure you come to watch!

title: Greeting
original: Uh huh, I'm listening.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! I wanted to fill your office with flowers, but my teacher said restraint is the first rule of Ikebana. So I made you this! And it should fit just fine on your desk!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: This blade brings nothing but trouble when I'm holding it. Good thing I can trust you to tell me where to swing it. That way, nothing can go wrong!
